g.text: Reset: mux disabled, PB8/BOOT0 held low by R307.

g.desc: Reset: mux disabled, PB8/BOOT0 held low by R307.

g.text: EN_N=0 enables VM sensing; wait >=2ms before ADC read.

g.desc: EN_N=0 enables VM sensing; wait >=2ms before ADC read.

g.text: SEL=0 grounds TIM4 inputs; SEL=1 connects external Hall/ABI.

g.desc: SEL=0 grounds TIM4 inputs; SEL=1 connects external Hall/ABI.

g.text: Onboard absolute-angle SPI is independent of this switch.

g.desc: Onboard absolute-angle SPI is independent of this switch.

g.text: Inputs 0-5.5V; U603 is powered from 3V3. DNP pull-ups prevent rail backfeed in push-pull mode.

g.desc: Inputs 0-5.5V; U603 is powered from 3V3. DNP pull-ups prevent rail backfeed in push-pull mode.

g.text: C604 is required; no 3V3 clamp tie.

g.desc: C604 is required; no 3V3 clamp tie.

g.text: EXTERNAL HALL / ABI: 3.3V or 5V logic -> 3.3V Schmitt buffer -> reset isolation

g.desc: EXTERNAL HALL / ABI: 3.3V or 5V logic -> 3.3V Schmitt buffer -> reset isolation

g.text: R604 is NOT a current limiter.

g.desc: R604 is NOT a current limiter.

g.text: Do not fit for externally driven push-pull.
